methods.baseline_origin_comment: The authors describe separate global and local training and testing of the generic models. The specific DeepLab recipe is not reported.

split.value: The released train/val/test lists contain 454/207/142 distinct images, with no duplicates or intersections, and match the corresponding MagNet sets. The CVPR paper reports 455/142/206. The split version used for the published table is unresolved.

class_set.value: The logged summary averages 6 classes. Class 0 (unknown) remains in the pooled 7x7 confusion matrix and is excluded only from the final IoU mean. The seven-class iou_mean in metrics.py is not the value used by the main log.

aggregation.value: The implementation accumulates a 7x7 confusion matrix across images, computes class IoUs, and averages the six named classes. nan_to_num maps absent-class values to 0.

test_input.value: The paper specifies 500x500 global and local inputs and at least 50 pixels of patch overlap. The released evaluation script uses local patches and a global image resized to 508x508; local inputs are also 508x508. The default test=False branch has no TTA. The alternative test branch uses horizontal flipping and four rotations. This evidence is from code inspection.

eval_split_reported.value: Paper Table 3 explicitly refers to the local DeepGlobe test set. The released eval_deep_globe.sh runs the crossvali validation directory.

code_default_vs_paper.value: Both reported class means exclude unknown. The released evaluation defaults to validation, whereas the paper table describes test results. The paper's 500-pixel input differs from the code's 508-pixel input, and the reported split counts differ from the released lists. The execution underlying the published scores remains unresolved.

baseline_source.value: The source table reports DeepLabv3+ local 63.1 and global 63.5. The authors describe training and testing each method globally and locally. Patch training/inference uses 500x500 inputs, while each global model uses a feasible downsampling setting to control memory. The exact DeepLab global input size, backbone, initialization and epoch count are not reported, and its configuration is absent from the repository. The GLNet R50-FPN recipe describes a different model.
